answer: Attestation credit in this economy decays by design. Each attestation is stamped with the epoch it was earned and loses half its weight every twelve epochs, so an identity counts only for work it keeps renewing. A sybil ring must feed ten thousand accounts on a rotation: each needs fresh peer attestations before its credit fades, and when attention drifts the whole set rots together. A farm pays ten thousand operators labour and cannot park identities on a ledge to mature. The decay is smooth as velvet, no cliff to time, and no harbor where a cloned fleet anchors until the tide returns.
